question: Should the initial quota-planning rollout ship as the proposed universal Codex, Claude, and Antigravity feature, including the headline/planning presentation described by the companion design, or be narrowed before the remaining store and menu work proceeds?
rationale: This is a new user-facing planning capability, and the remaining lifecycle and presentation work determines the permanent product surface rather than a purely mechanical implementation detail.

options.title: Approve the universal initial rollout
options.body: Complete the existing descriptor-driven rollout for Codex, Claude, and Antigravity using the companion design's approved presentation semantics.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Limit the initial implementation to one provider or a smaller presentation surface before generalizing the lifecycle and UI integration.

options.title: Pause for design consolidation
options.body: Resolve the companion design PR before committing to store lifecycle and menu behavior in this implementation.

recommendation.title: Approve the universal initial rollout
recommendation.body: Complete the existing descriptor-driven rollout for Codex, Claude, and Antigravity using the companion design's approved presentation semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The related design references maintainer direction in the repository's feature discussion, which is the clearest available ownership signal for this product-surface choice.
